series.title: Choose what each gesture does
series.sub: Taps, holds and swipes, for every app or just one

steps.title: Open Actions
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, tap Actions. Every tap, hold and swipe the bar understands is listed here.

steps.title: Try a gesture on the pad
steps.text: The pad at the top holds your real bar. Try a gesture on it, and the line below says what that gesture does.

steps.title: Pick a gesture to change
steps.text: Tap a gesture to change it. Double tap does nothing yet, so give it a job.

steps.title: Choose an action
steps.text: Actions come in groups: the bar, volume, the Deck, your device, media and system. Tap one and you are done.

steps.title: Give an app its own gestures
steps.text: Under More, open Gestures for chosen apps, tap Add and pick the app.

steps.title: Change a gesture just there
steps.text: Set Swipe up to Increase brightness. In Video, swiping up now brightens the screen; everywhere else it works as before.
